items.title: D'Andre Swift: Believed to be dealing with cramp
items.body_text: Swift (abdomen) is believed to have left Thursday's practice with "a cramp," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Seemingly avoids serious setback
items.body_text: Odunze "should be all good" after leaving Thursday's practice with an apparent right leg injury, Dan Wiederer of the Chicago Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Sustains apparent leg injury
items.body_text: Odunze sustained an apparent right leg injury during Thursday's practice session, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Leaves practice with injury
items.body_text: Swift left Thursday's practice with an apparent injury and "appeared to be in significant discomfort," Dan Wiederer of the Chicago Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Coach talks him up
items.body_text: Coach Ben Johnson lauded Williams' approach Tuesday as the quarterback enters his third NFL campaign, Larry Mayer of the Bears' official site reports. "He's executing at a much higher clip than he ever has, and I think it's going to continue to grow," Johnson said. "He's going to continue to elevate everyone around him, coaches included." Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
